Trade | US Congressman Vern Buchanan “Fair trade means more jobs for hardworking Americans. If we can grow our exports, we will better Florida’s economy as we send our goods, services, and products to people around the world. “As a member of the House Ways and Means Trade Subcommittee, I’ve worked to expand international trade and investment opportunities that create jobs and grow our economy, while also protecting businesses here at home. With Florida’s robust export base, from tomatoes and aerospace to medical technology and tourism, trade is vital to our state’s economy. “International trade supports over 39 million American jobs, including more than 2 million in Florida. The vast majority of Florida exporters are small and mid-sized businesses with fewer than 500 employees, making free and fair trade agreements essential to opening new markets for American-made goods and services. “I remain committed to advancing trade policies that put American workers first, strengthen our supply chains and give Florida businesses the tools to compete and win in the global economy.” Read Related News More Updates ICYMI: Buchanan Calls for USMCA Reforms to Protect Seasonal Produce Growers in The Hill Op-Ed “This USMCA review gives our country a real opportunity to restore fairness for our seasonal produce growers,... I’ve introduced legislation to expand access to nutritional food for our veterans, address critical gaps in mental health care for veterans and review the deaths of all veterans treated by the VA who died by suicide or from a drug overdose. Education | US Congressman Vern Buchanan “As a blue-collar kid who was the first in his family to go to college , I know from personal experience the importance of a high-quality education for our nation’s youth. I also know from having worked my way through college that an education is a privilege, not a right, and that we must continue to instill the values of hard work into the next generation. “During my time in Congress, I’ve supported legislation to serve our students and improve our education system. My VETS Credit Act, which previously passed the House of Representatives, helps student veterans by ensuring they are able to quickly and easily transfer their course credits to another institution should their school close or program end suddenly. I’ve also introduced bills to expand nutritional education for medical students and encourage private schools to enroll more American students. “I am committed to ensuring our students have access to quality education and opportunities to succeed. Health Care | US Congressman Vern Buchanan “With nearly 200,000 seniors in my district and tens of thousands of my constituents enrolled in Medicare or Medicaid, I understand the importance of fixing our broken health care system so that every American has access to quality, affordable care. “As Chairman of the Health Subcommittee on the House Ways and Means Committee, I have fought to pass policies that protect the most vulnerable, empower individuals and families with control over their health care choices and personalize health care to meet individual needs. I’ve been on the forefront of policy discussions to extend flexible health care options for all Americans, such as with my Permanent Telehealth from Home Act , and I will always advocate patient-centered reforms that get the federal government out of your doctor’s office. “As Co-Chairman of the bipartisan Congressional Preventive Health and Wellness Caucus, I’ve sought to bring attention to the rising chronic disease crisis in our country. With six in 10 Americans living with at least one chronic disease, it is clear that we must expand options for people to manage their chronic health conditions. I’ve introduced legislation, such as my Chronic Disease Flexible Coverage Act , which passed the House with unanimous bipartisan support in 2025, to give patients more flexibility to manage their chronic diseases while reducing high out-of-pocket costs. I am committed to protecting Floridians and raising awareness about how public health issues impact lives and communities. “In 2026, I was proud to see two of my key health care priorities signed into law, marking a major step forward in expanding access to care and modernizing our system. My Hospital Inpatient Services Modernization Act extended the successful Hospital-at-Home program, allowing more patients to safely receive acute care in the comfort of their own homes. Additionally, my Permanent Telehealth from Home Act removed outdated geographic restrictions under Medicare, ensuring seniors and families can access care no matter where they live. These bipartisan achievements reflect my continued commitment to delivering innovative, patient-centered solutions

Immigration & Border Security | US Congressman Vern Buchanan “A secure border is a secure nation. We must stop illegal immigration, restore law and order, and put Americans’ safety first. “Under the Biden administration, the crisis at our southern border spiraled out of control. That’s why voters elected a Republican majority—to secure the border, stop the flow of deadly fentanyl, and restore strong leadership that puts America first. “Keeping Americans safe is my top priority in Congress. I’ve introduced legislation like the Protecting Our Communities from Sexual Predators Act , which ensures that illegal immigrants convicted of sexual assault are deported and permanently banned from reentering the United States. I also introduced the Criminal Alien Gang Member Removal Act to keep violent gang members off our streets by denying them asylum and mandating immediate deportation. “I’m proud to have helped lead efforts on the Ways and Means Committee to pass the reconciliation package, which funds the largest deportation operation of criminal aliens in American history, completes the border wall, supports our Border Patrol agents, and ensures that those seeking to come to America do so legally and through the front door. “I’m committed to enforcing the rule of law, securing our border and putting America and Americans first.” Read Related News More Updates Buchanan Applauds Passage of Secure America Act to Fully Fund ICE and Border Patrol, Combat Fentanyl Delivers Resources Needed to Secure the Border, Combat Human Trafficking, Keep Communities Safe WASHINGTON — Today,... Jobs & Economy | US Congressman Vern Buchanan “Creating jobs and revitalizing the U.S. economy is my highest priority, and encouraging growth in the private sector is vital to achieving this goal. Too often, Washington enacts policies that increase regulation, raise taxes and place heavy burdens that hold American job creators back. As a businessman for over 30 years, I know what it’s like to create jobs, balance a budget and make payroll. “As the Vice Chairman of the powerful House Ways and Means Committee, I will continue to work to restructure our tax system to make it simpler, flatter and fairer. We need a tax code that spurs economic growth, creates jobs and puts money back in the pockets of hardworking taxpayers. I was proud to help lead the House’s efforts to pass the Working Families Tax Cuts in 2025 to lower taxes for hardworking families, seniors and small businesses. This tax package also included four of my own bills to address issues of importance to Florida. I fought to eliminate federal income taxes on tips for Florida’s tens of thousands of hospitality and tourism workers. I also worked to restore the mortgage insurance premium deduction and fix unfair condominium accounting rules to provide tax relief for middle-class families struggling while housing prices skyrocket in Florida. Finally, I achieved permanency for key provisions of the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act to make permanent tax cuts for individuals and small businesses across our state. “I will always fight for commonsense, pro-growth, pro-family, America First bills that create jobs and grow our economy.” Read Related News More Updates ICYMI: Buchanan Calls for Senate to Pass His Permanent Daylight Saving Time Bill in Sarasota Herald-Tribune Op-Ed “Now the Senate has the Opportunity to Finish the Job.” WASHINGTON — Today, Congressman Vern Buchanan penned an... Family Values | US Congressman Vern Buchanan “American families are the foundation of our nation and our values. I will always stand up for life, protect the unborn and support parents’ rights. “As a father and grandfather, I know firsthand the importance of giving every child the opportunity to grow up in a safe, loving home. We have a responsibility to support families and ensure they have the resources and opportunities necessary to provide their children with the best possible future. “In Congress, I’ve consistently supported efforts to expand access to parenting resources and strengthen the Child Tax Credit to help ease the financial burden on working families. “Supporting life isn’t just about policy, it’s about standing up for the children, parents and grandparents who make up the backbone of our communities. National Security | US Congressman Vern Buchanan “Peace through strength has always been the cornerstone of American leadership. “Our nation and our way of life are under threat from authoritarian regimes like China, Russia, North Korea and Iran, along with their terrorist proxies. These regimes are destabilizing regions, spreading violence and challenging American interests both abroad and here at home. Now more than ever, we must invest in our military’s readiness and lethality. “As someone who proudly served in the Air National Guard, I understand the importance of a strong national defense and have championed efforts in Congress to support our servicemembers, ensuring they have the means to succeed.
